hero.h1: Directive 8020 Collectibles | Edition Content & Tracking Guide
hero.intro: Start by identifying which content you own. A location guide is only useful when it refers to the same edition, version and story progress as your save.

blocks.text: The Steam deluxe upgrade describes additional Dark Pictures collectibles, including figures from earlier anthology games. Its page says the Steam base game is required. This establishes the extra content, not a complete map of every item in the main game.

items: Confirm the base game and add-ons shown in your library.
Read the listing for your own platform rather than assuming every package uses identical names.
Distinguish an edition bonus from a main-story collectible.
Check whether the relevant content is available in your installed version.

blocks.text: For each item, note its in-game name, chapter, nearby objective, required prior choices and whether it is recorded as collected. A screenshot or save reference can make a location reproducible. Keep item discoveries separate from untested trophy requirements.

sections.heading: About the old total and locations

blocks.text: The previous claim of 65 items and its sample room locations were not backed by a checked official location list, so they are no longer presented as a completed route. This does not establish that those rooms or items cannot exist. Exact counts and routes need direct verification.

Before replaying, review your play style and available Turning Points. A supported rewind feature does not prove that every collectible is recoverable from every checkpoint. Confirm the item’s actual state after your attempt.
